items.label: FIGURE 3A.1
items.title: The evolution of World Bank Vision and Scorecard indicators for food and nutrition security
items.content: The figure contains three line charts showing trends in food and nutrition security indicators. Panel a: Global prevalence of undernourishment (%), x-axis 2001-2023, y-axis 7-14%. Shows a downward trend from approx. 13.5% in 2001 to approx. 8% around 2015-2017, followed by a slight increase. Panel b: Global prevalence of stunting of children under five years (%), x-axis 2000-2022, y-axis 20-34%. Shows a steady downward trend from approx. 33% in 2000 to approx. 22% in 2022. Panel c: Global prevalence of moderate or severe food insecurity (%), x-axis 2014-2023, y-axis 21-31%. Shows an upward trend from approx. 22% in 2014 to approx. 25% in 2019, followed by a sharp increase to approx. 29% in 2020, remaining relatively stable thereafter. Sources: Panels a and c are reported by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO); panel b is reported by the United Nations Children’s Fund, the World Health Organization, and the World Bank, all accessed through the FAOSTAT database.
